summary: Teardown for a physics-config style object. First calls SessionConfigDefaultInit on the whole object to reset its configuration fields, then frees up to three heap-allocated pointer fields (offsets 0x14, 0x8, 0x0) via FreeWrapper_7bcf, each guarded by a non-null check, and returns the last FreeWrapper result (or the saved value of field 0x8 when that field was null).

operations.description: Invoke SessionConfigDefaultInit(this) to reinitialize/reset the object's configuration fields before any pointers are freed.
Guard: only free the pointer at offset 0x14 (this + 20) when it is non-null.
Free the heap pointer at offset 0x14 via FreeWrapper_7bcf(*(this + 20)).
Load result = *(this + 8), the second heap-allocated pointer field, before its null check.
Guard: only free the pointer at offset 0x8 when result (the loaded value) is non-null.
Free the heap pointer at offset 0x8 via FreeWrapper_7bcf(*(this + 8)) and keep its return value as result.
Load v3 = *(this), the first heap-allocated pointer field at offset 0x0.
Guard: only free the pointer at offset 0x0 when v3 is non-null.
Return the FreeWrapper_7bcf result for the offset 0x0 pointer when it was freed, otherwise the earlier result (from offset 0x8 or its null fallback).
Called by AutoLoadEntryListLoader (0x00432E70), which tears this object down as part of loading the auto-load entry list.

unresolved: The concrete object type is unknown; the destructor-shaped call to SessionConfigDefaultInit before freeing suggests a physics/session config record, but only the three pointer-field offsets are evidenced.
Exact types of the freed allocations at offsets 0x0, 0x8 and 0x14 are unknown.
Whether SessionConfigDefaultInit is a plain field reset or performs additional allocation is outside this function's evidence.
